results.title: Software Engineer Salary in Australia: What Tech Pros Earn
results.description:
# Software Engineer Salary in Australia: What Tech Pros Earn
For a solid, mid-level engineer, you're generally looking at an annual salary between **AUD 130,000** and **AUD 170,000**.

## Decoding Your Potential Earnings in Australia
### Software Engineer Salary in Australia At a Glance
| Experience Level | Average Annual Salary (AUD) | Potential High End (AUD) |
|-|-|-|
| **Senior (5-8 Yrs)** | AUD 160,000 - AUD 200,000 | AUD 220,000+ |

## Why Your City Determines Your Paycheck
### Average Software Engineer Salary by Major Australian City
| City | Average Mid-Level Salary (AUD) | Notes on Local Market |
|-|-|-|
| **Sydney** | $150,000 - $180,000 | The epicentre of tech and finance. Highest competition drives top-tier salaries, but also the highest cost of living. |
| **Melbourne** | $140,000 - $170,000 | A close second to Sydney, with a booming startup scene and major tech HQs. Slightly lower cost of living can be a drawcard. |
| **Brisbane** | $120,000 - $150,000 | A rapidly growing market with a strong focus on SaaS and fintech. The salary gap with the southern cities is closing. |
| **Canberra** | $130,000 - $160,000 | Dominated by government and defence contracts. High demand for engineers with security clearances, leading to very competitive pay. |

## Strategies for Negotiating Your Ideal Salary
### Navigate the Conversation
| Component | Target Value |
|-|-|
